items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: When my son was young I formed a band. Oh. You know and I had him playing around all these little places you know.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, they had Germany. They had the Kaiser. They had the Kaiser then Kaiser they were around. What about your sons? When did they start playing?

Well, my son started playing around the late 40s. Mm-hmm. Little drummer. He started playing. He was born in 37. Mm-hmm. And he started playing at 15 years old. Which one is that? Is that John L. Jr.?
That's John L. Jr. Yeah. Right.
